added_failures_note: unmeasured: the reviewed manifest names no base gate log, so the added-failure count was not taken; supplemental: the reviewed run declares no baseline_suite/after_suite pair, but the arms it did run each report no FAILED id -- gate_head.log 7 passed, gate_existing_backends.log 61 passed, gate_backends_surface.log 167 passed -- and the only FAILED lines in the run directory are the intentional negative control.
call_sites: reckon/crew/dispatch.py:1546 (dispatch passes the resolved config as fence_config)

findings.text: follow-on: _declared_worker_mcp_servers is fed the resolved flight config, but reckon/flight.py:320 _schema_view removes only harness_home_files, harness_home_adjacent_files, sprint_recent_days and the review-owned keys, so a top-level worker_mcp_servers is refused (measured: resolve(overrides={"worker_mcp_servers": ["imas-cx"]}) raised FlightConfigError 'Extra inputs are not permitted'); the opt-in half is inert in production and tests/test_worker_mcp_servers.py:140 injects fence_config directly, so no test catches it.

blocking: the file is outside the run's declared write paths and its edit, like tests/test_harness_home_carries_the_operator_config.py:184, is required because both asserted the seeded settings.json held only the operator hooks key -- the contract the section supersedes -- so the change cannot land as declared without a coordinator granting the scope extension or reworking the section to leave that key set unchanged.

follow-on: the fragment reports the launch/seed surface as "166 passed" while gate_backends_surface.log, the log the same run cites, records 167 passed, so the record and its log disagree on the count.

item_verdicts.diff: read commit by commit against c5afaf59e; 8c9e4276e adds WORKER_MCP_SERVERS, the two settings-key constants, the worker_mcp_servers parameter and _declared_worker_mcp_servers/_seed_worker_mcp_settings in reckon/_backends.py, threads the declaration through launch_plan, adds tests/test_worker_mcp_servers.py and updates two existing assertions; 700fc0f62 adds the 30-line evidence fragment.
item_verdicts.done_when: the done-when names tests/test_worker_mcp_servers.py; I re-ran it at head 700fc0f62 -- 7 passed EXIT=0 -- and read the run's own negative control gate_negative.log, which removes the seeded write and fails EXIT=1 with 4 test ids the head arm passes; the named-server case is asserted only by injecting fence_config, not through flight resolution.
item_verdicts.goal: the node goal is that a dispatched worker's harness starts the reckon server and no project .mcp.json server unless the project names one; reckon/_backends.py:2264-2266 writes enableAllProjectMcpServers=false and enabledMcpjsonServers into the seeded settings.json, retiring the implicit every-server default, but the opt-in half is unreachable in production because reckon/flight.py:320 _schema_view does not exempt worker_mcp_servers, so a project cannot declare it (measured: resolve(overrides) raised FlightConfigError 'Extra inputs are not permitted').
item_verdicts.manifest: read; it names commits 8c9e4276e and 700fc0f62, three gate logs and the negative control, reports 7 passed and 167 passed, and itself flags the out-of-scope test edits under blockers; its test_logs omit gate_existing_backends.log (61 passed) and baseline.log (54 passed) that sit in the run's logs directory.
item_verdicts.write_paths: the manifest declares reckon/_backends.py, tests/test_worker_mcp_servers.py, the evidence fragment and the figures directory, but git diff --name-only c5afaf59e 700fc0f62 also lists tests/test_fence_is_on_again.py and tests/test_harness_home_carries_the_operator_config.py, both outside the declared scope.

justifications.durability: removing _seed_worker_mcp_settings reddens 4 assertions (gate_negative.log EXIT=1), but tests/test_worker_mcp_servers.py:140 injects the same server name it later asserts at :144, and nothing asserts the flight-config path that would make the opt-in reachable.
justifications.evidence: the gate tests/test_worker_mcp_servers.py passed 7 at EXIT=0 and the negative control gate_negative.log is red EXIT=1 with 4 ids, but the named-server assertion at tests/test_worker_mcp_servers.py:140 supplies fence_config directly, so it measures a config flight resolution never produces.
justifications.fit: the new constants and helpers at reckon/_backends.py:2029-2266 follow the module's module-constant and _-prefixed-helper idiom beside _merge_harness_entry, and carry no plan label, version suffix or author attribution.
justifications.goal_fidelity: the disable-group half lands at reckon/_backends.py:2264 and retires the every-server default, but reckon/flight.py:320 leaves worker_mcp_servers in the schema view so a project cannot declare the opt-in list (measured refusal), leaving half the goal's mechanism inert.
justifications.reuse: a search of reckon/ for enableAllProjectMcpServers/enabledMcpjsonServers found no prior writer, so _seed_worker_mcp_settings extends the single seeder rather than forking a capability.
justifications.scope_discipline: the diff touches tests/test_fence_is_on_again.py:165 and tests/test_harness_home_carries_the_operator_config.py:184, neither in the declared write paths, though both edits are forced because the done-when requires those existing assertions to be updated to the key set the section supersedes.
